messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off Spruce Labs onboarding. Objectives: integrate API into staging, complete security review, and run a pilot load test within 14 days. Who's on point and what are the top risks?

sam_csm: Stakeholders: Claire (PM/business), Raj (eng lead), Priya (security). They want a compact 2-week pilot with frequent demos.

leo_pm: Timeline suggestion: daily standups days 1-4, then Tue/Thu check-ins. I'll draft a 14-day milestone doc and share by EOD.

anya_eng: Perf note: p50 ~200ms on redwood-small for typical prompts; p95 varies with batching and context length. If they insist on long contexts or high concurrency, Dedicated capacity may be required. I'll send a short perf matrix today.

tom_se: EU-only processing ask: we can route to eu-hosted region for pilot; Private deployment is possible but adds lead time and SOW. I'll outline options with estimated timelines and costs.

onboard-bot: ACTION CREATED: #3201 - "Spruce EU data options" assigned to tom_se, due 2024-11-07.

sam_csm: Feedback plan: create a shared integration doc + #spruce-feedback channel. Propose a short daily 3-question pulse for first 5 days. I'll own the pulse and digest.

maria_cs: Great. Action list: anya -> perf matrix; tom -> EU options + SOW sketch; leo -> milestone doc + invites; sam -> feedback form + channel. First standup tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll loop sales about reserved-capacity / billing cadence risk. :thumbsup:
